articles.title: v8.0.0-rc.18
articles.summary: v8.0.0-rc.18 Raw SQL in a contract is now always a sql literal or value, a full-text index can span several weighted fields and is searched from the ORM by naming it, and middleware observes each statement and transaction as an activity. PSL gains mixins, the SQL ORM gains whereUnique and firstOrThrow , and MongoDB migrations carry out --rename . The upgrade recipes for this hop: the app recipe and the extension recipe .
